$comment: Maps publicly discussed forum playbooks onto Argus Quant modules. Catalog only — not a live enablement switch. Default evaluateAll() remains five CORE strategies. Do not set experimental env vars to true to see if it works. Forum-claimed win rates / R:R are NOT Argus evidence. Forum 0.5–1% equity risk is NOT Argus sizing (RiskEngine uses PositionSizing + settings.maxTradeSize).
riskNote: Argus does not adopt forum position-sizing, daily 2R circuit breakers, or structural stops as RiskEngine replacements. RiskEngine uses PositionSizing + settings.maxTradeSize. Invalidation text on experimental modules is thesis language only.

strategies.honesty: Uses MarketContext relativeStrengthVsSPY (period % vs SPY), stock-up/SPY-down divergence, SMA50/SMA200 stack, and EMA9/EMA20 as the closest existing EMAs (not 8/21). 1OP is not a data source. Breadth remains NOT_SUPPORTED. UNVALIDATED.

Requires real intraday bars for openingRange. Daily bars fail closed (no fabricated OR). VWAP alignment and RVOL are existing VolumeFeatures. Window minutes come from quantExperimentalStrategies.thresholds.openingRangeWindowMinutes. UNVALIDATED. Backtest is long-only.

strategies.forumName: Auction Market Theory, footprint, DOM, CVD, Bookmap
strategies.reason: No L2/DOM, no footprint, no CVD, no volume profile VAH/VAL/POC. Alpaca IEX is top-of-book. VOLUME_CONFIRMATION is RVOL+CMF/MFI only. UI must not show a fake ladder.

strategies.honesty: Pattern classification (sweep + structure). FVG-fill-as-entry and order-block mitigation are NOT standalone evaluate() modules. Sweep detector isTradeSignal false. UNVALIDATED. Live only if QUANT_SMC_STRATEGY_ENABLED=true. Backtest long-only.

strategies.forumName: VWAP mean reversion and VWAP trend pullback
strategies.honesty: VWAP_MEAN_REVERSION fades distancePct vs session VWAP in a range. VWAP_VOLUME_STRUCTURE is the trend-pullback cousin. Standard-deviation VWAP bands are not a separate feature (distancePct only). UNVALIDATED.

strategies.forumName: The Wheel (CSP / covered call) and premium selling
strategies.reason: No options chain, delta, IV rank, assignment, or multi-leg OMS. Argus does not sell cash-secured puts or covered calls.

strategies.forumName: 0DTE index options and dealer GEX / gamma walls
strategies.reason: No options chain, no GEX/DEX, no dealer positioning feed, no 0DTE expiration engine. Gamma-exposure aliases in the 760-name taxonomy are already NOT_SUPPORTED.

strategies.honesty: Uses existing VolatilityFeatures (band width + CONTRACTING then Keltner expansion break). Not a second Bollinger library. UNVALIDATED.
Rolling close z-score from statistics.ts plus RSI extreme in SIDEWAYS_RANGE. Lookback and |z| threshold live in quantExperimentalStrategies.json. Not pairs/cointegration. UNVALIDATED.
